nodes.name: Electrocatalyst Ink Preparation
nodes.procedure: To prepare the electrocatalyst inks, catalyst powder and ionomer solution (15% Nafion®) were dispersed in appropriate mixtures of water, with 1-propanol and 2-propanol in total volumes of 1-3 cm³ in cylindrical glass containers. The mixtures were agitated for two minutes in an ultrasonic homogenizer.
nodes.source_text: To prepare the electrocatalyst inks, catalyst powder and ionomer solution (15% Nafion®) were dispersed in appropriate mixtures of water, with 1-propanol and 2-propanol in total volumes of 1-3 cm³... agitated for two minutes in an ultrasonic homogenizer.

nodes.name: Electrode Coating
nodes.procedure: The electrocatalyst inks were then coated onto inert decal substrates by automated bar coating (Coatmaster 509 MCI, Erichsen GmbH & Co. KG).
nodes.source_text: then coated onto inert decal substrates by automated bar coating (Coatmaster 509 MCI, Erichsen GmbH & Co. KG).

nodes.name: CCM Hot-Pressing
nodes.procedure: The dried electrode layers were hot-pressed onto the cleaned Nafion®117 membrane at a temperature of 125 °C for about 30 s. The final catalyst loadings were 2.2 mg cm⁻² IrO₂ (at the anode) and 0.8 mg cm⁻² Pt (at the cathode).
nodes.source_text: The dried electrode layers were hot-pressed onto the cleaned Nafion® membrane at a temperature of 125 °C for about 30 s. The final catalyst loadings were 2.2 mg cm⁻² ~IrO₂ (at the anode) and 0.8 mg cm⁻² Pt (at the cathode).

nodes.name: TiPTL Platinum Sputtering
nodes.procedure: A layer of platinum was sputtered onto the porous titanium sinter plates (GKN T10, 42×42×1.5 mm) to serve as an anti-corrosion coating and prevent oxidation. (Pt layer ~200 nm thick)
nodes.source_text: porous titanium sinter plates (GKN T10, 42×42×1.5 mm, were used for the anode PTL... A layer of platinum was sputtered on to the TiPTL to serve as an anti-corrosion coating... (Pt layer ~200 nm thick)
